changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionDeletedAssetType') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionDeletedAssetType]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [Cascade] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_ApiExecutionDeletedAssetType_Cascade] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [AssetTypeID] [int] NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NULL, [IntersectTypeID] [int] NULL, [FromHierarchy] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_ApiExecutionDeletedAssetType_FromHierarchy] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionDeletedAssetType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [Uid] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[ExecutionDeletedAssetType]') AND name = 'HierarchyLevel' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[ExecutionDeletedAssetType] ADD [HierarchyLevel] int END
